title: Recovered work
originalRequest: Design and implement a stock rotation dashboard for a local food bank to optimize inventory management, track item expiration dates, and prioritize FIFO distribution.
latestMessage: Design and implement a stock rotation dashboard for a local food bank to optimize inventory management, track item expiration dates, and prioritize FIFO distribution.

steps.title: Set up database schema for inventory items with expiry tracking
steps.instruction: Define the PostgreSQL schema for stock items, including fields for item ID, category, expiration date, storage location (e.g., cold storage, dry shelving), and quantity.
steps.acceptance: Schema migration script executes successfully, creating the tables with correct constraints (non-nullable expiry, positive quantities).

steps.title: Implement First-In, First-Out (FIFO) queue priority logic
steps.instruction: Write the backend query helper that fetches available stock items sorted by proximity to expiration date to prioritize distribution of soon-to-expire food.
steps.acceptance: Helper function returns items ordered by ascending expiration date, grouping identical barcodes/categories.

steps.title: Develop stock alert notification system for aging items
steps.instruction: Create a background cron job that scans the inventory daily and triggers warning flags/notifications for items within 7 days of expiration.
steps.acceptance: Cron job correctly identifies expiring records and updates their alert status flags in the database without performance degradation.

steps.title: Create batch intake validation endpoint
steps.instruction: Build a REST API endpoint to bulk-insert new donations with validation for acceptable shelf-life buffer times (e.g., rejecting goods already expired).
steps.acceptance: POST endpoint returns a 400 Bad Request for any payloads containing expired dates or missing mandatory category labels, and 201 Created on valid batches.

steps.title: Build stock level visualization widgets
steps.instruction: Develop frontend UI components (charts/progress bars) representing aggregate stock capacity by food category (dairy, canned, grains).
steps.acceptance: React dashboard correctly displays current volume metrics vs maximum storage capacity limits dynamically fetched from backend API.

steps.title: Add search and filtering capabilities to the inventory view
steps.instruction: Add input fields to filter the dashboard table view by category, expiration range, and donor identifier.
steps.acceptance: Users can filter inventory records on the frontend instantly using client-side or server-side filtering without breaking pagination.
